name: flow
description: Four manual workflow commands for Claude Code: /flow:go (work discipline — verify before acting, fix root causes, consider security, never report false progress), /flow:cm (batched, spec-compliant commits), /flow:e2e (profile the project, plan, human review, generate Playwright specs, run and heal, report) and /flow:pin (reproduce one UI bug with a Playwright spec, then fix it and keep the spec as a regression test). Manual-only; they do not auto-activate.
